verdict.rationale: Unleash has a dedicated first-party guide for scheduling feature releases at a specific date and time. It uses a `currentTime` constraint with the `DATE_AFTER` operator. Separately, change requests can group changes and apply them at a specific point in time, which covers scheduled flag changes beyond simple activation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detail on scheduled change requests (setup, plan availability), which is only a one-line mention.
